requirements.statement: When git-auto-backup completes, the timer shall wait fifteen minutes before the next run and shall first arm five minutes after timer activation.
acceptance_criteria: OnActiveSec is 5m and OnBootSec is absent
The fixed OnCalendar schedule is absent

ears.response: wait fifteen minutes before starting another run

breaker.condition: backup uses boot-relative or wall-clock catch-up scheduling

requirements.statement: While git-auto-backup runs, systemd shall constrain its concurrency and resource priority.
acceptance_criteria: Nice is 19 and IOSchedulingClass is idle

ears.response: run with the declared resource guardrails

breaker.condition: backup lacks any declared resource bound or exceeds two workers

requirements.statement: When the periodic backup sweep runs, it shall back up Git and non-default jj workspaces without repository hooks or live-branch publication, while a separate hourly low-priority completion-relative unit preserves the workspace ledger before daily cleanup can erase it.
acceptance_criteria: ledger rsync runs only from workspace-ledger-snapshot
ledger timer uses OnActiveSec=10m and OnUnitInactiveSec=1h without OnCalendar or Persistent

ears.response: avoid validation/build hooks and live publication while preserving the ledger separately

breaker.condition: a push invokes validation, advances a live branch, or ledger preservation remains in the backup hot path
